title: House of Wilds is now on Google Play
summary: Our first official Android Google Play release is here: Drunk Yeti’s House of Wilds.
imageAlt: Yeti’s Frost Lock, a slot machine hosted by the Yeti in House of Wilds.
body: Drunk Yeti’s House of Wilds is officially available on Google Play. Bring the studio’s wild slots, character-led casino tables, and seven-night reward wheel to your Android device.
Visit the game page for screenshots, the studio trailer, and the browser edition. Google Play has device compatibility, age rating, and current availability.
This is the start of our studio release journal. We’ll use it to share real launches, updates, artwork, and official trailers as they become available.

title: Schmuck Deluxe is now on Google Play
summary: Empty your hand and climb from Schmuck to President in Drunk Yeti Studio’s 3D card game, now available for Android.
imageAlt: A hand of cards in front of the green table in Schmuck Deluxe.
body: Every round can change who sits at the top of the table. Play by Classic rules, make Poker combinations, or try Collection rules as you race to empty your hand.
Practice against AI offline or pass a device around for a local game. Visit Google Play for device compatibility and the current release details.
